title: Database disk full from runaway export job
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the db disk‑full caused by the new export job.
option_titles: Disable export job and move largest export file to root disk
Disable export job and move two smaller export files to root disk
root_cause: A continuous data export job deployed 1 hour ago writes large CSV files to /var/lib/postgresql/exports/ every minute, filling the PostgreSQL volume (50 GB) to 100 % capacity. This causes PostgreSQL "No space left on device" errors, which propagate to the API, resulting in order failures and admin export timeouts.
truth: A new data export job runs every minute and writes large CSV files to /var/lib/postgresql/exports, filling the 50 GB database disk so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
check_first: Investigate the api container logs and its health status
